rule: GOAL: Align the pink strip's glyphs to match the transformation of the blue strip. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the selector between slots; UP and DOWN cycled the selected glyph. RULE: Each glyph followed a fixed seven-step cycle, so the shortest path to the target was either UP or DOWN. TRAP: Assuming only DOWN worked caused unnecessary extra presses when UP was the faster route.

GOAL: Reach the green goal by moving two cells at a time across the floor. CONTROLS: Arrow keys jump your character two squares in the chosen direction. RULE: Jumps only work if the square you land on is clear, skipping over the middle one. TRAP: Assuming the middle square must be empty; it is ignored, so only your landing spot matters.

GOAL: Move the square to the blue circle. CONTROLS: Click a grid cell to jump the square to that location. RULE: Jumps have a maximum range of three cells; shorter moves are allowed. TRAP: Believing longer jumps are possible wasted time on failed clicks outside the three-cell limit.

GOAL: Position the paddle so a falling block spreads across its entire width. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the paddle left or right; spacebar drops the block. RULE: Blocks smear over the paddle and drip off both ends, filling cups only if aligned perfectly. TRAP: Assuming the block stays intact; ignoring the split causes drips to miss cups or hit walls, wasting time.

GOAL: Align two gray bands so their combined width stays fixed while shifting edges. CONTROLS: Click the blue block to shift the lower band’s right edge and the upper band’s left edge simultaneously. RULE: The sum of the two bands’ right edges remains constant; expanding one shrinks the other by an equal amount. TRAP: Assuming the bands move independently or that total gray area changes; they do not, only their distribution does.

GOAL: Expand the bottom gray band to the target width. CONTROLS: Clicking buttons shifts adjacent bands horizontally, pushing width from one band to another. RULE: Width flows in a chain; top shifts middle, middle shifts bottom, requiring sequential clicks to transfer space. TRAP: Clicking the bottom button first fails; you must first expand the middle band by shrinking the top one.

GOAL: Place the white and grey shapes so their exact midpoint aligns with the ring's center. CONTROLS: Clicking a shape moves it to that spot; clicking an occupied spot swaps the two shapes. RULE: Symmetry is key: position the shapes equidistant from the center in opposite directions. TRAP: Assuming you must move the grey shape first; moving the white shape to the target position first allows a cleaner swap sequence.

GOAL: Push blue-headed blocks into the container slots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the character; Space drops the held block. RULE: Blocks only stick when placed adjacent to the player. TRAP: Deposited blocks look like new obstacles; they are static decorations, not interactable items.

GOAL: Turn every switch black to power the device. CONTROLS: Clicking a switch flips its bar and stem colors independently. RULE: All ten segments must be black simultaneously to complete the circuit. TRAP: Assuming one click clears a switch; each part toggles separately, so you must click twice to reset a segment.

GOAL: Align seven rotating shapes to match the reference row's specific colors. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the cursor; pressing up or down rotated the selected shape. RULE: Each shape cycles through a fixed color sequence; match the target by finding the shortest rotation path. TRAP: Assuming all shapes rotate in the same direction; some required upward presses to reach the target state faster.

GOAL: Move a yellow dot down and a green dot right to meet at a central plus sign. CONTROLS: Click the bottom half of a colored box to move its dot down, or the right half to move it right. RULE: Only the specific half of each box controls movement; the other half is inert. TRAP: Clicking the wrong side of a box wastes actions without moving the dot, draining the timer.

GOAL: Transform the input row into the target row by applying specific shape-shifting rules. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the selector; DOWN cycled the shape in the selected slot forward through its transformation sequence. RULE: Each slot followed a fixed seven-step cycle, requiring precise calculation of steps to reach the target shape. TRAP: Assuming shapes could be chosen randomly; blind cycling wasted actions, whereas calculating the exact distance from the start shape saved time.

GOAL: Reach the exit by timing movement against a lunging guard. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step; guard attacks if aligned. RULE: Guard lunges only when player is in the same row, not column. TRAP: Assuming column alignment triggers attacks; safe passage exists vertically.

GOAL: Raise pool levels to match target heights behind walls. CONTROLS: Click left to raise left pool, lower right. Click right to raise right pool, lower left. RULE: Water cannot rise above the lowest wall top in its section. TRAP: Believing you can push water over a low wall to fill a higher section.

ESTABLISHED: The arm retracts in steps of five, not six. The tip extends through blocks, leaving a visible stub beyond the object. FAILED: Assuming uniform six-unit movement for both extension and retraction. GOAL IS NOT: A simple push or pull with equal distance in both directions. CONTROLS: Left and right inputs move the arm; the tip penetrates objects while the base stops at obstacles.

GOAL: Match target shapes by cycling through options. CONTROLS: Arrows moved selection; Down cycled shape. RULE: Connectors between boxes defined true pairs, not just proximity. TRAP: Assuming adjacent same-color boxes paired caused false rules and wasted moves.

GOAL: Arrange three orange nodes so their center lands on the target dot. CONTROLS: Click a node to pick it up, then click a new spot to drop it. RULE: The center is the average of the three node positions, not just their visual middle. TRAP: Ignoring that moving one node shifts the center of the whole group, causing overshoots.

GOAL: Reach the exit while avoiding guards that lunge two tiles in their facing direction. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one tile at a time. RULE: Guards attack only if the player is exactly two tiles away in their line of sight. TRAP: Standing one tile away is safe, but standing two tiles away triggers an instant lunge.

GOAL: Guide the water stream to the target cup by managing obstacles. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the paddle; mouse clicks swap object colors; space triggers the flow. RULE: Blue objects block water, while red objects allow it to pass through. TRAP: Assuming a blocked path is dead ends; sometimes moving a blocker sideways clears the route.

GOAL: Match the top color sequence by filling the middle slots in exact order. CONTROLS: Click a bottom button to select a color, then click a middle slot to place it. RULE: Placing a color moves its button to a gray placeholder, consuming one step from the budget bar. TRAP: Thinking selection alone counts as an action; only filling a slot reduces the step counter.

GOAL: Match the right bank's lit cells to the left bank's current shape silhouette to validate the puzzle. CONTROLS: Click cells to toggle their state; click the ball to submit your configuration for verification. RULE: The shape's orientation dictates the required pattern; rotate the shape to align its silhouette with your target. TRAP: Assuming the target pattern is static; it changes based on the shape's current rotation and position.

GOAL: Reach the exit while avoiding a lunging guard and a patrolling enemy. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player two tiles in the chosen direction. RULE: Enemies move after you; landing on a guard destroys it, but the patrol kills on contact. TRAP: Assuming the patrol bounces off walls; it reverses direction only when blocked, requiring precise timing.

GOAL: Navigate the assembly to the central plus by extending and retracting colored bars. CONTROLS: Click left on a panel to shorten its bar; click right to lengthen it. RULE: Bar lengths must always remain positive, preventing full retraction. TRAP: Assuming you can shrink a bar to zero to pass through tight gaps wastes moves, as the minimum length is strictly one.

GOAL: Position both colored crosses so their arms perfectly cover the matching dots on the grid. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active cross three spaces per press; Spacebar switches between the two crosses. RULE: A cross is solved only when its center aligns exactly with the intersection of its target dot pairs. TRAP: Believing arms extend infinitely; they have fixed lengths, so centers must sit precisely within specific row and column ranges.

GOAL: Move the yellow block to the bracketed target position. CONTROLS: Red clicks shift blocks left; green clicks shift blocks right. RULE: Clicking an arrow rotates the ring in that direction. TRAP: Thinking arrows move blocks directly; they only rotate the whole ring.

GOAL: Cover all red dots using the diamond's outline. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the active shape; Space cycled to the next shape. RULE: Dots are cleared only when a shape's border pixels align with them. TRAP: Assuming shapes could pass through each other; overlapping objects hide their underlying pixels.

GOAL: Move the piece from start to finish using the fewest clicks possible. CONTROLS: Click a piece to select it, then click a highlighted green square to move it there. RULE: Pieces travel in straight lines across empty spaces until they hit an obstacle or edge. TRAP: Thinking you can stop mid-path; you must land on the exact final square, not just near it.

GOAL: Light the four cardinal cells to match the left-side hint pattern and clear the grid. CONTROLS: Arrow keys select cells; pressing an arrow lights the corresponding cardinal position. RULE: Lighting exactly the white pattern cells triggers level completion and shrinks the player head. TRAP: Believing the head shrinks due to a penalty; it actually indicates progression after a correct match.

GOAL: Make the highlighted panel's outer ring match the hidden pattern logic. CONTROLS: Click outer cells to toggle their color between blue and red. RULE: The center mini-pattern indicates which ring positions must be red. TRAP: Clicking the center mini-pattern does nothing; focus only on the outer eight cells.

GOAL: Clear grid cells to shrink the head, then navigate it up to the base. CONTROLS: Click white cells to erase them; use arrow keys to move the head two spaces per press. RULE: Movement steps are fixed at two cells, locking the head to a specific column parity that must align with the path. TRAP: Assuming you can shift one cell sideways to center the head; the two-step movement prevents this, forcing a specific starting alignment.

GOAL: Move the block to cover the glowing plus sign. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the entire block one cell in that direction. RULE: The level ends only when the block fully obscures the target marker. TRAP: Believing the marker was just decoration; ignoring it wasted moves circling the board.

GOAL: Position three shapes so their edges cover all target dots on the board. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the currently active shape one step; Space switches to the next shape. RULE: Each shape covers dots within a fixed radius; align centers precisely to intersect all targets. TRAP: Assuming any starting order works wastes moves; verify the cycle to minimize unnecessary Space presses.

GOAL: Turn blue cells orange to match the hidden mini patterns. CONTROLS: Click a grid cell to toggle its color. RULE: The mini icons show which cells in the panel must be orange. TRAP: Thinking the top-right blocks were controls; they were just a legend.

GOAL: Move two yellow tiles onto the marked target spots using the board’s shifting tracks. CONTROLS: Top arrows rotate the main loop clockwise or counter-clockwise; side arrows shift specific rows left or right. RULE: Rotating the main loop moves all connected tiles together, while side arrows only affect tiles currently in that row. TRAP: Assuming side arrows rotate the main loop; they only slide tiles horizontally within their specific row track.

GOAL: Arrange colored tiles to spell a hidden message by threading them through a connected pipe system. CONTROLS: Click a tile to select it, click another to swap them, and press Space to submit the sequence. RULE: Reading order follows the physical path, diving into the green box via the socket before returning to the red box. TRAP: Assuming a standard grid order misses the pipe connection, causing the message to read incorrectly despite correct tile placement.

GOAL: Fill seven slots across three colored zones using tray letters to match a hidden sequence. CONTROLS: Click a tray letter to select it, then click a slot to place it; press space to submit the arrangement. RULE: Slots fill in a continuous snake order from left to right, treating each colored zone as a single sequential block. TRAP: Assuming each color zone operates independently causes mismatches; the sequence flows continuously across all zones regardless of color boundaries.

GOAL: Move the cross to touch the color swatch and switch its hue. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the cross; Space toggles which cross is active. RULE: Any part of the cross touching the swatch updates its color. TRAP: Thinking only the center point counts; the arms extend far and trigger changes easily.

GOAL: Place the connector ring and fill slots to match the top sequence. CONTROLS: Click tray pieces to select, click board slots to place, press space to verify. RULE: The ring inserts the green box at its red slot position; the pre-filled green node must align with the matching sequence number. TRAP: Assuming the ring can go anywhere; placing it incorrectly shifts all subsequent slots, breaking the color alignment.

GOAL: Arrange the ring slots so the blue color pattern repeats identically in both boxes. CONTROLS: Click rings to place them; click colors to fill slots; press space to submit. RULE: The sequence between rings must match exactly when shifted, proving slot positions 2 and 3 are correct. TRAP: Assuming any ring placement works; wrong positions break the repeating pattern, wasting time on invalid fills.

ESTABLISHED: The maze is mostly symmetric but has two specific asymmetries in the bottom corners. FAILED: Assuming perfect symmetry for movement paths; standard swapping logic failed due to blocked mirror cells. GOAL IS NOT: A simple symmetric swap of the two blocks' starting positions. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move blocks; UNDO reverses the last move but consumes time.

GOAL: Arrange rings to order three color boxes, then fill their slots to match a hidden sequence. CONTROLS: Click tray items to select, click grid slots to place, press space to verify. RULE: Each ring in the main row reveals a box whose colors appear in that specific order. TRAP: Assuming rings act as fillers; they are only keys that unlock and sequence the hidden color boxes.

GOAL: Move yellow and orange tokens to their matching colored brackets. CONTROLS: Red clicks rotate rings forward; green clicks rotate them backward. RULE: Rings share two cells, allowing tokens to switch paths between loops. TRAP: Assuming rings are independent; they are not, so ignoring shared cells blocks progress.

GOAL: Determine the correct color for each grid cell using static mini hints to reveal the target pattern. CONTROLS: Clicking grid cells toggles their color; clicking mini hints does nothing as they are static references. RULE: Mini patterns map to grid neighborhoods, but only when rotated to face the board center, resolving all conflicts. TRAP: Assuming minis map to neighborhoods without rotation or that clicking minis rotates them wastes time on false leads.

GOAL: Move the segmented head to the teeth slot to trigger the clearing mechanism. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the entire chain; clicks clear gray trail cells. RULE: The head cannot pass through black walls, forcing a specific path around the obstacle. TRAP: Assuming the trail color change indicated a blocked path rather than just history.

ESTABLISHED: Blue moved to (32,14). Gray appeared at (8,20), then moved to (8,26). Blue is blocked by red when moving down. FAILED: Moving blue down while blocked did nothing. Pressing space repeatedly did not change blue's position. Moving left was blocked by walls. GOAL IS NOT: The gray block is not a simple mirror or delayed replay of the blue block's exact path. CONTROLS: Up moves blue up. Left is blocked by walls. Down is blocked by red. Space triggers state changes but does not move blue directly.

ESTABLISHED: One box fits the left socket. The right corridor is blocked by a solid wall. FAILED: Pushing the second box into the wall while the first is seated. Swapping active box focus. Waiting for the bar to empty. GOAL IS NOT: Opening the wall via socket activation. Covering the wall. Surviving the timer. CONTROLS: Clicking swaps which box is active. Arrow keys move the active box.

GOAL: Position two colored blocks onto specific marked target squares. CONTROLS: Click arrows to shift horizontal rows or vertical columns as cyclic tracks. RULE: Blocks move with the track they sit on; only intersection cells allow changing direction between rows and columns. TRAP: Assuming a block can move freely across the grid; it is stuck on its current row or column until it reaches an intersection.

GOAL: Recolor the grid to match hidden targets using nested mini-grids. CONTROLS: Click cells to cycle blue to red to orange. RULE: Mini-grid colors map to the large grid, requiring specific color shifts per cell. TRAP: Assuming a simple two-color toggle; the three-color cycle doubled the clicks needed for orange cells.

GOAL: Rotate the plug so its prongs face the wall sockets. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug; spacebar rotates it clockwise. RULE: The prongs must align perfectly with the socket holes to connect. TRAP: Assuming the plug fits any orientation; it only connects when facing the correct direction.

GOAL: Align the charcoal piece perfectly with the yellow target shape. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the charcoal piece step by step across the grid. RULE: The Γ shape had to match the yellow outline exactly to win. TRAP: Assuming the black piece needed moving wasted time; only the charcoal mattered.

GOAL: Align the black piece's reflection with the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the active object; SPACE switched control between the mirror line and the black piece. RULE: White dots indicate which object is currently controllable. TRAP: Assuming arrows always move the piece, ignoring that the mirror line held initial control.

GOAL: Guide the token to the exit while managing a strict, shrinking time limit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the token two cells, skipping the intermediate square. RULE: Movement fails if the destination is a wall, ignoring the middle cell. TRAP: Assuming the bar decreases by one per move; it shrinks with real time.

GOAL: Align the gray fluid’s edge with the wall by moving the object right. CONTROLS: Clicks moved the object horizontally; each step shifted the fluid boundary. RULE: The object acts as a piston, pushing the gray mass to match the target shape. TRAP: Assuming the gray area was static; it flowed dynamically with every movement.

GOAL: Move the core to the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the core; clicking shirts toggles bar orientation. RULE: The core can only pass through a slot if the blue block is solid there, not a checker. TRAP: Assuming the red bar orientation alone determines the path, ignoring that the blue block must be positioned to fill the gap.

GOAL: Guide the block through the gap by aligning it with the exit. CONTROLS: Left buttons pump fluid to expand the corridor; right buttons push the block sideways. RULE: The block consumes corridor width as it moves, so you must widen the space before advancing. TRAP: Pushing the block without first expanding the room causes it to hit a wall and stall.

GOAL: Position the line to reflect both pieces onto their matching yellow zones. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space cycles which shape is active. RULE: Reflection flips vertically across the line, requiring the line at row 28. TRAP: Assuming the T-piece could fit the top zone, but its stem orientation forbids it.

ESTABLISHED: Purple paint stops at the canvas center, leaving the wedge permanently unreachable. FAILED: Attempting to paint the wedge directly or via complex stroke combinations to match the reference image. GOAL IS NOT: Reproducing the exact reference pattern on the canvas, as the wedge cannot be filled. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the brush angle; Spacebar applies a stroke of the selected color.

ESTABLISHED: The level is a vertical maze ending at a pink plus at the very top. FAILED: Moving the player to the right side of the upper room failed to trigger the win. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the top room or standing adjacent to the pink plus. CONTROLS: Clicking blocks removes them if open space exists above or below; directional buttons move the player in fixed grid steps.

GOAL: Click toggles to match the hidden target pattern of black and gray cells within the step limit. CONTROLS: Left-click toggles a cell between black and gray; the blue bar shrinks with every click. RULE: The solution requires specific cells to be black while others remain gray; trial and error reveals the match. TRAP: Believing the yellow shapes are interactive keys or that clicking causes permanent transient changes wasted valuable steps.
GOAL: Reach the pink plus in the top room. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player. RULE: Only the pink plus counts as the goal. TRAP: Thinking reaching the room alone wins; you must touch the plus.

ESTABLISHED: Three blocks sit at specific coordinates; a blue panel with gray interior remains inert. FAILED: Arranging blocks around or below the panel did not trigger a win. GOAL IS NOT: Filling the panel's row or sealing it with blocks. CONTROLS: Movement shifts position in four-cell steps; carrying lifts blocks; dropping places them adjacent.

GOAL: Merge separated black pieces into one solid block to cover the hidden yellow shape. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected object; SPACE cycles which object is active. RULE: Moving an object through a mirror line reflects its position across that axis. TRAP: Assuming objects are independent; they merge upon overlap, and small fragments may be hidden by the active piece.

GOAL: Raise water in three tanks to match purple markers while keeping others empty. CONTROLS: Click buttons to move two units of fluid between adjacent tanks. RULE: Fluid spills over the shorter side wall, capping each tank's maximum height. TRAP: Assuming walls block flow equally; the shorter wall limits capacity, not the taller one.

GOAL: Reach the green exit without dying to the red guard. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the token one step in that direction. RULE: The guard moves two spaces toward you only when you are within two cells in its row. TRAP: Assuming the guard's starting position is safe to occupy, leading to a fatal move when proximity triggers.

GOAL: Push all three blocks into the blue-rimmed pit to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player; Space attaches or releases a block. RULE: The pit’s size exactly matches three blocks, confirming it is the destination for all pieces. TRAP: Trying to stand inside the pit to trigger a win wastes time; only blocks fill the goal.

GOAL: Move the purple square to the plus sign and collect it. CONTROLS: Clicking within range moves the purple square toward the target; clicking far away does nothing. RULE: The purple square only reacts to clicks within a short radius, sliding along the trail to the destination. TRAP: Believing clicks work anywhere wastes actions; distant clicks on trail dots or empty space are ignored.

GOAL: Align the horizontal bar so falling blocks drop into the two cup-shaped notches below. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the bar left or right; Spacebar drops the blocks from the bar's ends. RULE: Position the bar's center between the cups so left and right blocks align with their respective holes. TRAP: Ignoring horizontal alignment causes blocks to hit solid cup walls or miss entirely, wasting time.

ESTABLISHED: Pink glyphs form a seven-shape family; blue glyphs are a separate family. The key maps six specific blue shapes to six pink shapes. FAILED: Exact shape matching for the bottom row; assuming blue glyphs belong to the pink alphabet. GOAL IS NOT: A simple direct lookup where bottom blue shapes exactly match key blue shapes. CONTROLS: UP rotates the active shape; inputting the mapped pink shape clears the column.

GOAL: Guide the token to the marked square at the bottom-left corner. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the token two spaces in the chosen direction. RULE: Red enemies only attack if you approach directly from the direction they face. TRAP: Assuming all reds are lethal; you must check their facing to see if a safe approach angle exists.

GOAL: Move two matching squares to a shared spot and click there to merge them into the next size. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell moves a square toward that spot; clicking an overlapping spot merges them. RULE: You only merge when the two squares fully overlap in the same cell. TRAP: Assuming you can merge from a distance; you must first move them together.

GOAL: Arrange four colored dots to match the top row's sequence. CONTROLS: Click a color in the bottom palette, then click a dot slot to swap them. RULE: Matching the top pattern completes the level; only swaps consume your move count. TRAP: Thinking clicks are free; selecting without swapping wastes no moves, but placing does.

GOAL: Match the bottom blue row to the key’s pattern to reveal the hidden pink sequence. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selector between columns; pressing UP cycles the glyph through its rotation states. RULE: Each blue glyph corresponds to a specific pink one; rotating the blue rotates its paired pink the same way. TRAP: Assuming all rotations are valid. Only the specific rotation matching the key’s orientation yields the correct answer; others are decoys.

GOAL: Guide the token to the goal while avoiding a patrolling orange guard and crushing a stationary red guard. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the token one step per turn. RULE: Moving into a guard from a side perpendicular to its facing direction destroys it instantly. TRAP: Assuming the guard's patrol path is static; it actually bounces, requiring precise timing to avoid collision.

GOAL: Push the plug into the narrow socket to insert it. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the plug along the track. RULE: The plug shrinks to fit the narrowing groove as it moves inward. TRAP: Trying to solve the grid pattern separately instead of just pushing the plug to the end.

GOAL: Align two cross-shaped cursors over their matching colored dot clusters. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active cursor three spaces; Space switches the active cursor. RULE: Each cursor must land on the unique intersection of its color’s horizontal and vertical dots. TRAP: Assuming one cursor handles all dots wastes moves; you must toggle between them to position each separately.

GOAL: Move two colored blocks into matching target circles using minimal clicks. CONTROLS: Clicking a block moves it directly toward the clicked location; the click point acts as the block’s anchor corner. RULE: Match block size to anchor logic; larger blocks need precise targeting to align centers with circle centers. TRAP: Assuming the click sets the block’s center causes misalignment for larger blocks, wasting moves on correction.

GOAL: Rearrange colored tokens to match hidden target positions. CONTROLS: Click one slot to select, click another to swap; press space to verify. RULE: Swapping two filled slots exchanges their contents instantly. TRAP: Assuming clicks move items sequentially rather than swapping positions directly.
GOAL: Clear the path to the handle. CONTROLS: Click white squares; press arrows. RULE: Match the pattern to shrink the plug. TRAP: Thinking the full plug fits the narrow gap.

GOAL: Fill seven empty slots by routing rings through connected color panels. CONTROLS: Click palette colors to place rings into matching panel slots, then press Space to verify. RULE: Follow the visual flow where pipe mouths force rings into the next connected panel. TRAP: Assuming all red slots are independent; pipe mouths actually redirect rings to other panels.

GOAL: Rotate glyphs to match the reference key. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the selector and rotated the highlighted tile. RULE: Each press applied a specific geometric transformation to the current cell’s pattern. TRAP: Assuming rotation order was irrelevant; the sequence of transforms altered the final glyph orientation.

GOAL: Align colored pipes to match the pre-filled letter hint on the green panel. CONTROLS: Click palette items to swap them into empty slots, then press space to confirm. RULE: The pipe sequence must follow the color order that satisfies the fixed letter constraint. TRAP: Assuming the ring belongs in the first slot; it actually fits the third position to match the hint.

GOAL: Guide the diamond shape to collect three specific red dots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active shape; Space cycles through available shapes. RULE: A shape collects a dot only when it overlaps the dot's exact position. TRAP: Assuming diagonal pixels form a solid block; the diamond's outline is fragile, and empty boxes remain after collection.

GOAL: Extend colored bars from their caps to align their head dots with matching plus signs. CONTROLS: Clicking a bar cell adjusts its length, pushing or pulling the head dot along the axis. RULE: The level completes only when every head dot sits precisely on its corresponding plus center. TRAP: Assuming overlap ends the level; visual merging is not completion, as exact alignment is required.

GOAL: Move three shapes to specific spots to clear the board. CONTROLS: Arrows move the current shape; Space switches to the next one. RULE: Only the shape under the cursor responds to arrow keys. TRAP: Assuming you can move any shape instantly; you must cycle through them to control each.

ESTROLISHED: R sits at slot0, N at slot4; b is held. The stack order R, b, N failed to clear the level. FAILED: Placing b between R and N, or testing right-to-left HUD readings, did nothing. GOAL IS NOT: Matching the visual HUD order in the central stack column. CONTROLS: UNDO reverses one move. LEFT/RIGHT moves the arm; DOWN places the held block.

GOAL: Move the single yellow block to the top-left slot marked by brackets. CONTROLS: The red arrow rotates the ring counter-clockwise; the green arrow rotates it clockwise. RULE: Each arrow click shifts every block one position along the ring. TRAP: Assuming the colored arrows or side blocks were targets wasted moves; only the yellow block’s position matters.

GOAL: Push the block onto the marker to unlock the exit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block in the cardinal directions. RULE: The marker is a switch, not a pickup; standing on it changes the panel to match the door. TRAP: Thinking the marker was a collectible to grab, rather than a floor tile to stand on to trigger the mechanism.

GOAL: Place the white diamond precisely inside the empty ring. CONTROLS: Clicking a spot moves the white diamond there; the purple diamond follows as a midpoint shadow. RULE: The white diamond must be fully contained within the ring's boundary to win. TRAP: Assuming the purple diamond was an independent object to move; it is only a reflection of the white one's position.

GOAL: Match all shapes to their designated slots on the red and blue panels. CONTROLS: Click a palette piece, then click a slot to swap them. Press space to submit. RULE: Swapping a piece into a slot sends the slot’s current piece back to the palette’s empty space. TRAP: Assuming you can drag pieces directly; you must click twice to swap, or the move fails.

GOAL: Position the 4x4 plug at the passage mouth and fire it right to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrows move and orient the plug; clicks trigger the match action. RULE: The plug shrinks to fit narrow gaps only when fired directly into an obstructed opening. TRAP: Assuming the plug stays rigid; it actually compresses to slide through tighter spaces than its size suggests.

GOAL: Determine panel order by matching the first letter of each panel's slot one to the target sequence, then fill remaining slots with matching palette solids. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select them, click empty slots to place them, and press space to submit. RULE: The first letter of each panel’s slot one must match the corresponding segment of the target string to establish the correct flow order. TRAP: Assuming panels must be filled in visual left-to-right order rather than logical flow order based on the target string.

GOAL: Clear all pegs by jumping over each other into empty spaces on the board. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click an adjacent empty space to jump into it. RULE: You can only jump over a neighboring peg into an empty space directly beyond it. TRAP: Assuming you can jump multiple times in a row without re-selecting the landed peg.

GOAL: Move both yellow tokens onto their matching brackets. CONTROLS: Click arrows to rotate loops; green reverses the direction of the adjacent loop. RULE: Only the yellow tokens' positions matter; other colors are irrelevant distractions. TRAP: Assuming green arrows behave like red ones; they rotate in the opposite direction, causing wasted moves if unchecked.

GOAL: Recolor scattered shapes by moving objects onto matching colors. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space switches between shapes. RULE: An object changes color when its arms touch a region of that color. TRAP: Assuming paths must be direct; taking detours to touch intermediate colors is often necessary to prepare the next move.

ESTABLISHED: The maze is thick with no dead ends, allowing movement to a merged block above the notch. Controls for the right square are horizontally inverted relative to the left. FAILED: Pressing Up to place both squares on the bar did not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply placing both squares on the horizontal bar. CONTROLS: Standard directional inputs move the left square; horizontal inputs are mirrored for the right square.

GOAL: Move Y to the yellow slot and O to the orange slot. CONTROLS: Left arrows spin the left circle; right arrows spin the right circle. RULE: Rotating a circle shifts all blocks on it, including shared cells, allowing transfer between circles. TRAP: Assuming blocks stay on their starting circle ignores how shared cells enable cross-circle movement.

GOAL: Change the bottom-right grid to match the pattern shown in its center. CONTROLS: Click cells to toggle colors and build the target shape.
